title: Select all sections (close/reopen), section date of loss, Type of coverage
walkthroughSteps: Section overview: tick sections (or select all), then Close or Reopen them in one go (AC-01). Closing several is the bulk closure of BMPCC-22660.
Claim overview, Reopen claim: select all or any section, then a confirm step (AC-02).
Section date of loss: column, change window, confirm, toast; follows the claim unless set (AC-03).
Type of coverage: renamed on Entities & damages (AC-04) and added as a Section overview column (AC-05).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC01 · Section overview: select all or any section, then close or reopen exactly the selected ones
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Sections of CLM-2024-001 (1 open section, 3 closed).

**You see:** A checkbox on every section row and a **select all** checkbox in the table header.

**Try:** Tick select all: a grey bar says **4 sections selected** with **Reopen 3 sections** and **Close 1 section**. Untick one closed section: the bar changes to **Reopen 2 sections**. Press it: the Reopen window lists exactly those 2 and asks for one reason; after **Reopen 2 sections** a toast names them. **Clear selection** empties the bar.

Decision: one selection drives both actions; each button only takes the sections it applies to and says how many. One section uses the existing single windows, two or more the bulk ones (bulk closure is BMPCC-22660). Selection is off when the claim is closed.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** Jira AC01 asks for a select-all control and close/reopen of exactly the selected sections. The prototype decides one shared Close/Reopen bar for the selection, and turns selection off when the claim is closed. Not in Jira, pending product sign-off.

expectedUI.description: Close and reopen apply to exactly the selected sections.
visualCues: Reopen window lists the selected sections

howToTest.expectedResult: Close and reopen apply to exactly the selected sections.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC02 · Reopen claim: select all or any closed section, then confirm
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Claim Overview of CLM-2024-001, claim Closed, all 4 sections closed.

**You see:** The **Reopen Claim** button.

**Try:** Reopen Claim, pick a reason, **Continue**. The section step has **Select all (4)** and a checkbox per section, with **2 of 4 selected** next to it as you tick. **Continue**: the new confirm step says which sections reopen and which stay closed. **Reopen claim and 2 sections**: toast "Claim reopened. 2 sections reopened. 2 sections remain closed."

Decision: added a confirm step, so select all is never a blind click. At least one section must be picked when there are several (unchanged).

visualCues: Confirm step: reopened vs stays closed

howToTest.trigger: Reopen Claim, reason, Continue, tick 2 sections, Continue, Reopen claim and 2 sections.
howToTest.expectedResult: Select all and per-section ticks, then a confirm step with what reopens and what stays closed.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC03 · Section date of loss: shown per section, edited per section, follows the claim unless changed
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Sections of CLM-2024-001. **Property Damage: Warehouse & Forklift** has its own date of loss (20-01-2024); the claim's is 14-01-2024.

**You see:** A **Date of loss** column. That section reads 20-01-2024 with "Claim: 14-01-2024" under it; the others read 14-01-2024 (they follow the claim).

**Try:** Section menu, **Change date of loss**: choose **Same as the claim** or **A different date for this section** (no future dates). **Continue** shows the Field / Original / Updated confirm (same as Edit claim); **Confirm changes** saves and a toast confirms. The section detail panel (menu, Edit) shows the same date with "Same as claim" or "Own date" and a **Change** link.

Decision: unset means the section follows the claim, also when Edit claim changes the claim's date later; a section only keeps its own date when a handler sets one. Picking the claim's date again goes back to following it. Entities without their own date start from their section's date.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** Jira AC03 asks to show "how it relates to the claim-level DOL" but does not say how. The prototype decides "Same as claim" / "Own date": a section follows the claim unless a handler sets its own date. Not in Jira, pending product sign-off.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** Jira says nothing about entity dates. Entities without their own date starting from their section date is made up by the prototype. Not in Jira, pending product sign-off.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AC05 · Section overview: "Type of coverage" column
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Sections of CLM-2024-001.

**You see:** A **Type of coverage** column between Status and Damage, worded like Entities & damages (e.g. FLExA for Building, Business Interruption caused by FLExA). The section detail panel shows it too.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** in production the cover comes from what each entity was matched to; the prototype shows a default cover per damage type (core/mock/data/section-coverage.json) unless the section has its own. Treated as `done`, pending product sign-off.
